paragraphs.text: 1. THEN was not non-existent nor existent: there was no realm of air, no sky beyond it.
paragraphs.original: नासदासीन्नो सदासीत्तदानीं नासीद्रजो नो व्योमा परो यत्।
paragraphs.translit: nāsadāsīnno sadāsīttadānīṃ nāsīdrajo no vyomā paro yat|

paragraphs.text: What covered in, and where? and what gave shelter? Was water there, unfathomed depth of water?
paragraphs.original: किमावरीवः कुह कस्य शर्मन्नम्भः किमासीद्गहनं गभीरम्
paragraphs.translit: kimāvarīvaḥ kuha kasya śarmannambhaḥ kimāsīdgahanaṃ gabhīram

paragraphs.text: 2. Death was not then, nor was there aught immortal: no sign was there, the day's and night's divider.
paragraphs.original: न मृत्युरासीदमृतं न तर्हि न रात्र्या अह्न आसीत्प्रकेतः।
paragraphs.translit: na mṛtyurāsīdamṛtaṃ na tarhi na rātryā ahna āsītpraketaḥ|

paragraphs.text: That One Thing, breathless, breathed by its own nature: apart from it was nothing whatsoever.
paragraphs.original: आनीदवातं स्वधया तदेकं तस्माद्धान्यन्न परः किं चनास
paragraphs.translit: ānīdavātaṃ svadhayā tadekaṃ tasmāddhānyanna paraḥ kiṃ canāsa

paragraphs.text: 3. Darkness there was: at first concealed in darkness this All was indiscriminate chaos.
paragraphs.original: तम आसीत्तमसा गूळ्हमग्रेऽप्रकेतं सलिलं सर्वमा इदम्।
paragraphs.translit: tama āsīttamasā gūḷhamagre'praketaṃ salilaṃ sarvamā idam|

paragraphs.text: All that existed then was void and formless: by the great power of Warmth was born that Unit.
4. Thereafter rose Desire in the beginning, Desire, the primal seed and germ of Spirit.
paragraphs.original: कामस्तदग्रे समवर्तताधि मनसो रेतः प्रथमं यदासीत्।
paragraphs.translit: kāmastadagre samavartatādhi manaso retaḥ prathamaṃ yadāsīt|

paragraphs.text: Sages who searched with their heart's thought discovered the existent's kinship in the non-existent.
paragraphs.original: सतो बन्धुमसति निरविन्दन् हृदि प्रतीष्या कवयो मनीषा
paragraphs.translit: sato bandhumasati niravindan hṛdi pratīṣyā kavayo manīṣā

paragraphs.text: 5. Transversely was their severing line extended: what was above it then, and what below it?
There were begetters, there were mighty forces, free action here and energy up yonder
6. Who verily knows and who can here declare it, whence it was born and whence comes this creation?
paragraphs.original: को अद्धा वेद क इह प्र वोचत्कुत आजाता कुत इयं विसृष्टिः।
paragraphs.translit: ko addhā veda ka iha pra vocatkuta ājātā kuta iyaṃ visṛṣṭiḥ|

paragraphs.text: The Gods are later than this world's production. Who knows then whence it first came into being?
paragraphs.original: अर्वाग्देवा अस्य विसर्जनेनाथा को वेद यत आबभूव
paragraphs.translit: arvāgdevā asya visarjanenāthā ko veda yata ābabhūva

paragraphs.text: 7. He, the first origin of this creation, whether he formed it all or did not form it,
paragraphs.original: इयं विसृष्टिर्यत आबभूव यदि वा दधे यदि वा न।
paragraphs.translit: iyaṃ visṛṣṭiryata ābabhūva yadi vā dadhe yadi vā na|

paragraphs.text: Whose eye controls this world in highest heaven, he verily knows it, or perhaps he knows not.
paragraphs.original: यो अस्याध्यक्षः परमे व्योमन्त्सो अङ्ग वेद यदि वा न वेद
paragraphs.translit: yo asyādhyakṣaḥ parame vyomantso aṅga veda yadi vā na veda
